sections.theory:
Penalties

Warning

For a warning a yellow card will be used, which will be given for the following reasons.

When the opponent is making a throw and the defending team breaches some law.

On playing a dangerous game.

On negative and aggressive behaviour.

Individually one warning will be given to a player once and to the whole team three times. After this, on every dangerous foul a punishment of two-minute suspension will be given.

Disqualification and expulsion from the match

When a player in one match has been suspended 3 times for 2 minutes, then for suspending him the third time a red card will be used. The disqualified player will immediately leave the field of play and the bench of the team, and the team will play with only 6 players for 2 minutes; however, on completion of 2 minutes a substitute player can play in place of the disqualified player.

Skills of handball

Stopping the ball

To stop the ball the player can use both hands. According to the direction and speed of the ball, bring both your hands into position in such a way that the whole ball comes into the hands. To stop a fast ball, as soon as the ball strikes the hands, move the hands backwards.
